slice: Natural conversation round 27: 'can you keep a secret?' answered socially, not as a topic
reply: Of course — what's on your chest? I've got you.

before.can you keep a secret?: I don't have a good answer on secret yet — what's it like from your side?

mechanism: assurance/trust questions (keep a secret, promise not to tell, can I trust you) get a warm reassuring reply instead of a dry topic follow-up ('no good answer on secret')
